question: Which of the following Indian singers has won a Grammy award?
solution:
The correct answer is __**A R Rahman.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **A R Rahman** is the Indian singer who has won a **Grammy award.**
 
• He won the award in the** Best Compilation Soundtrack **for Visual Media category for the soundtrack of the movie **Slumdog Millionaire in 2010.**
